scripts.deploy: npm run build -w @quiz-gomes/domain && npm run build -w @quiz-gomes/web && wrangler deploy --experimental-provision=false
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply quiz-gomes-questions-01 --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply quiz-gomes-core --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply quiz-gomes-questions-01 --remote --experimental-provision=false && wrangler d1 migrations apply quiz-gomes-core --remote --experimental-provision=false
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute quiz-gomes-core --local --file seeds/core-development.sql && wrangler d1 execute quiz-gomes-questions-01 --local --file seeds/questions-development.sql
